questions.question: What new thing does God promise to create in Isaiah 65?
options: New heavens and a new earth
A new covenant written on hearts
A new king from the line of David
questions.answer: New heavens and a new earth

questions.question: What does God promise about answering his people in Isaiah 65?
options: I will hide away my face from them until they at last turn back to me again
Before they call, I will answer; while they are yet speaking, I will hear
I will not answer at all the proud who have wholly forsaken my holy ways
Though they cry out to me both day and night, I will delay for very many years
questions.answer: Before they call, I will answer; while they are yet speaking, I will hear

questions.question: Isaiah 65 says the wolf and the lamb shall graze together in the new creation.
Behold, I create new heavens and a new _____.
Before they call I will _____, while they are yet speaking I will hear.
